protocol.aggregation: mean per-shape RMSE within condition, then equal mean over six conditions
protocol.development: 1,000 deterministic queries per training point cloud
protocol.validation: all official queries from three validation geometries
protocol.test: complete official testset_all.txt; 108 entries and 540,000 queries
protocol.test_overlap_note: The official test list includes validation geometries and is not a strictly disjoint third split.
protocol.test_evaluation_policy: The finalist was frozen before one test evaluation. The baseline was evaluated afterward only for controlled reporting.

limitations: The study has no randomized unphased control run, so it does not identify the causal effect of the workflow.
Development and validation were used repeatedly during model selection.
API token counts and monetary cost were not persisted by the loop.
